propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient transport without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are present and non-empty, allowing silent construction of a backend that will fail only at first API call with misleading errors
Cloud adapter lacks construction-time presence and format validation present in DC adapter, creating test-parity and error-reporting gap with DC's assert_env_ready guard

JIRA_USER must be validated as an email address (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) at construction time, as Cloud authenticates via Atlassian account email and bare handles silently fail with 401
Missing or invalid credentials should raise BackendEnvError at _build_jira_backend construction naming all missing variables and the anonymous-access consequence, preventing deferred failures
test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently documents and asserts silent construction behavior and must be flipped to assert loud failure for parity with DC
test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance uses an invalid JIRA_USER (non-email) in fixtures and must be updated to a valid email format so credential validation passes before conformance checks
